integrity: The operator-norm and Garsia/kernel-testing norms are distinguished; existing SRKT classifications and the variance identity are credited; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No all-subcritical higher-degree maximizing-radius classification; possible earlier equivalent scalar Poisson-variance threshold under other terminology. Finite diagnostics are not a proof.
scientific_scope: Hardy H2 Hankel operators with analytic symbols az+bz^m, m>=3, ab nonzero; exact origin norming threshold, critical kernel set and transition type.
title: Sharp origin-to-off-center transitions for kernel testing of two-frequency Hardy Hankel operators
